RateId.description: The unique identifier of the `Rate` to update.

NegativeOccupancyAdjustment.title: Decimal update value
NegativeOccupancyAdjustment.description: Amount added to the price when occupancy is less than the Space Category Capacity. Use a negative value to provide a discount for under-occupancy. Set to 'null' if not updated.

ExtraOccupancyAdjustment.title: Decimal update value
ExtraOccupancyAdjustment.description: Amount added to the price when the Space Category Capacity is exceeded.
